scripts.audio: node scripts/gen-sfx.mjs && node scripts/gen-bgm.mjs && node scripts/gen-vo.mjs && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs
scripts.render:loop: node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts PreShowLoop out/raw-loop.mp4 && node scripts/master-audio.mjs loop
scripts.render:countdown: node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts FinalCountdown out/raw-countdown.mp4 --props='{"minutes":5}' && node scripts/master-audio.mjs countdown
scripts.render:standby: node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Standby out/raw-standby.mp4 && node scripts/master-audio.mjs standby
scripts.render:all: npm run audio && npm run render:loop && npm run render:countdown && npm run render:standby
